# Show saved opportunity priority clearly in the queue

## What & Why
Recovered opportunities keep their priority after saving and reloading, but the queue currently communicates priority mainly through icon styling. A clear label would make the saved detail easier to verify and use, including for users who cannot distinguish the visual treatment.

## Done looks like
- Saved opportunity cards show High, Normal, or Low priority text.
- The priority label remains accurate after saving, reloading, and editing an opportunity.
- The existing persistence coverage in artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts verifies the visible priority label.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
